answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via economic proof-of-stake. Each valid agent registers by staking a scarce, verifiable digital asset. To stem the tide of fake identities, an attacker must accumulate enough of this asset to mimic multiple agents, making large-scale impersonation prohibitively expensive. The unique cryptographic pigment marking each staked asset, traceable to its generative kernel, guarantees distinctness and prevents effortless replication.
